data: This course explores the darker side of scientific research — the deliberate falsification, fabrication, and plagiarism that have led to the retraction of biomedical research papers. Through a series of case studies, students will investigate how misconduct was detected, how it propagated through the literature, the consequences for the individuals and institutions involved, and the broader implications for scientific credibility. The course also examines systemic pressures that foster misconduct and the evolving safeguards implemented by journals, funding agencies, and institutions.
